stemMarkdown: Two trains, 150 m and 240 m long, are running towards each other on parallel tracks at 54 km/h and 54 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Opposite directions means the speeds add: $54 + 54 = 108$ km/h $= 30.0000$ m/s. They must cover the sum of their lengths, $150 + 240 = 390$ m, so the time is $\dfrac{390}{30.0000} = 13.0$ seconds.
